Metadata.title: PokéCompanion
Metadata.description: Tools for Pokémon players: Pokédex, team builder, type calculator and collection tracker.

Header.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark mode

Home.title: Every Pokémon, card by card
Home.intro: Look up any Pokémon, see which types hit it hard, build your team and keep track of what you’ve caught.
Home.typesIntro: Each type has its own colour, the same on cards, teams and the calculator. Tap one to see its Pokémon.
Home.roadmapIntro: PokéCompanion ships in parts, like a collection opened pack by pack. This is the order:

pokedex.name: Pokédex
pokedex.description: A full entry for every Pokémon: stats, types, abilities and moves.

typeCalculator.name: Type calculator
typeCalculator.description: Pick one or two types and see their weaknesses and resistances at a glance.

evolutions.name: Evolutions
evolutions.description: Evolution chains with the exact method: level, item, friendship or trade.

database.name: Moves, abilities and items
database.description: Search any move, ability or item and find out which Pokémon use it.

accounts.name: Trainer profile
accounts.description: Your account, your preferences and a dashboard with your activity.

teamBuilder.name: Team builder
teamBuilder.description: Build teams of six and spot coverage gaps before you battle.

collection.name: Collection
collection.description: Mark the Pokémon you own, including shinies and regional forms.

community.name: Community
community.description: Share teams and collections with other trainers.

Home.handLabel: Five sample cards from the Pokédex

NotFound.title: Nothing here
NotFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

Pokedex.title: Pokédex
Pokedex.description: All {species} Pokémon and their {forms} regional forms, with number, types and generation. Search by name or number and filter by type, generation or region.
Pokedex.intro: The complete collection: {species} Pokémon and their {forms} regional forms, one per card. Search by name or number, and sort them by type, generation or region.
Pokedex.emptyDescription: Try another name or number, or remove a filter.

Pokemon.metaDescription: {name}: types, base stats, abilities and Pokédex entry.
Pokemon.noEntry: There is no entry for this Pokémon yet.
Pokemon.statsIntro: The base value of each stat, out of a maximum of 255. Every member of the species shares them.
Pokemon.evolutionIntro: Tap a card to open that Pokémon's page.
Pokemon.noEvolution: {name} does not evolve: it is the only card in its family.
Pokemon.matchupsNote: Based on its types, not counting abilities: Levitate, for example, cancels Ground damage.
Pokemon.formsIntro: The same species in other regions: a different look, different types and different stats.
Pokemon.noFormEntry: This regional form has no Pokédex entry in our data yet.

TypeCalculator.title: Type calculator
TypeCalculator.metaDescription: Weaknesses, resistances and immunities of any Pokémon type or pair of types, plus the full type chart.
TypeCalculator.intro: Which types hurt your Pokémon and which ones each attack hits hard. Using the chart current games use (Generation VI onwards).

hint.defense: Pick one or two: your Pokémon's.

empty.defense: Pick one or two types to see what hurts them and what doesn't.
empty.attack: Pick an attacking type to see which types it is effective against.

TypeCalculator.seeInPokedex: See Pokémon of this type in the Pokédex
TypeCalculator.chartIntro: Each row is the attacking type and each column the type of the Pokémon taking the hit. On a phone, swipe the chart sideways.
TypeCalculator.chartCaption: Damage multiplier of each attacking type (rows) against each defending type (columns). Cells without a number are normal damage, ×1.
